messages:
maya (VP People): Quick post-all-hands note on hiring & org updates. Dropping the essentials here and happy to answer brief Qs.

sam (CTO): Heads up: priority remains runtime + infra to reduce latency and improve reliability.

maya (VP People): FY headcount = 28 net new. Q2 burst will cover most urgent infra/runtime roles; Q3 steady hiring for product and devex.

lisa (People Ops): Recruit templates and interview rubrics will be posted to #recruiting within the day. Please escalate must-haves.

jordan (eng-manager): Can we get a CSV of before/after reporting lines for managers? makes 1:1s easier.

maya (VP People): Yes  we will publish a team-mapping playbook (before/after + manager scripts) by Thursday EOD.

nina (IC): Will promotion windows or calibration change because of the reorg?

maya (VP People): No change to promotion timing. Were updating role families; optional calibration session available next week.

harper (allhands-bot): :calendar: Event created: "Hiring sprint Q&A (managers)" Fri 10:00  maya, sam, lisa.

maya (VP People): Thanks all. If you have sensitive concerns about reporting changes, DM Lisa or me.
